stories.summary: After a massive realignment of U.S. science priorities last year, researchers are rebuilding — and reimagining — what has been broken.

stories.headline: U.S. demand for menopause hormone therapy has more than doubled recently
stories.summary: The use of menopause hormone therapy among women aged 40 to 74 rose from 2023 to 2026, suggests a study of a U.S. pharmacy database.

stories.headline: A brain region known for listening helps us speak
stories.summary: Recording Wernicke’s area as people try to speak could help researchers design brain implants that restore speech.

stories.headline: Solo meerkats can find their way back home
stories.summary: Meerkats wearing GPS trackers found their way home from more than a kilometer away, all by themselves.
